On the current normalized hourly basis, the safety-side rate is $6.00 per hour higher, or 37.5% above the clerk rate. This is bounded local documentary evidence and requires substantive validation of occupational and work-schedule comparability before analytic use; it is not a final wage-gap estimate, nationally representative result, prevalence claim, or causal finding.
